thread:
anya: Quick thread to resolve packaging tension: Microburst (very low commit + small burst credits) vs Reserved Lite (larger commit, predictable capacity). Need final gating for roadmap and what we ship in M1.

caleb_prod: We should pick one canonical launch SKU and one experimental pilot SKU. Launch SKU needs hard limits & billing behavior nailed.

lin_sales: From field: SMBs want something cheap to start ($500/mo) but with predictable performance; some will accept per-seat for plugin seats. They also ask for short-term trial boosts.

jess_eng: Engineering constraints: supporting dynamic burst pools per-customer + real-time enforcement costs ~2-3 sprints. Simpler path: pre-allocated burst credits attached to billing accounts that are consumed via the normal usage pipeline.

marc_fin: Revenue perspective: $500 commit with 1.5x burst pool vs $2k commit with 3x burst. Sensitivity: low commit increases acquisition but reduces margin. I want a modeled ARR at 12 months for both.

tanya_legal: Legal flags: any advertised "credits" must have clear expiration, non-transferability, and be called out in T&Cs. Also add a clause for capacity-based throttling to avoid promise violations.

caleb_prod: Proposed minimum launch decision: ship a single public SKU called "Microburst Lite" with defaults: commit $750/mo, soft daily token cap 500k, burst credits 250k that expire in 60 days. Offer an optional Reserved Lite enterprise SKU later.

lin_sales: Sales asks: allow pilot coupon to temporarily lift soft caps for 30 days and mark changes in audit log. We need a quick UI toggle for promo lift.

jess_eng: UI toggle is fine if product owner scopes it. Telemetry: we'll emit usage events to billing with ~20-40s lag; acceptance: 95% of events <60s at launch. Quota enforcement: per-account soft caps enforced in request path; hard caps in billing (post-factum).

marc_fin: Two concerns: (1) soft caps that are purely advisory create revenue leakage risk; (2) we must define overage pricing and auto-billing behavior. Suggest overage: 1.5x base token rate and auto-bill when credits exhausted.

tanya_legal: Overage auto-billing needs opt-in in the contract and notification windows. Also require exportable audit log entries for any auto-bill event.

anya: Launch acceptance criteria (draft):
- SKU and public limits doc published
- Billing events delivered to billing pipeline within 60s for 95% of events
- Overages are clearly documented and opt-in flow exists
- Pilot customer signed and ran at least 2 simulated load windows
- Telemetry + audit trail for any temporary cap changes
- Legal clause for credit expiry and throttling included

caleb_prod: We should also have SLA wording: Microburst Lite is not SLA-backed; Reserved Lite will have uptime targets. Make sure copy is clear to customers.

lin_sales: OK on SLA wording. Also request a product FAQ about seat vs metered options for SMBs.

jess_eng: Implementation note: to avoid a big backend change, we'll implement burst as preloaded credit balances and reuse existing metering pipeline. That means immediate launch possible within 3 sprints if PRD final by EOW.

marc_fin: I'll run the P&L with assumed utilization bands 25%, 45%, 65% and return numbers by Friday. Will include churn sensitivity.

tanya_legal: Draft clause for credits I'll put in PRD: "Issued burst credits expire 60 days after issuance, are non-transferable, and are subject to capacity-based throttling. Unused credits are not refundable."

billing-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: 1) Caleb: confirm final SKU name + commit level by Wed; 2) Jess: quota enforcement implementation estimate and sprint count by Tue; 3) Marc: P&L scenarios by Fri; 4) Lin: assemble 3 pilot candidates and pilot coupon plan by Thu; 5) Tanya: add credit & overage clauses to PRD.

anya: Thanks all. If we land the SKU name and commit by Wed we can lock scope for the M1 milestone. No objections raised here. :thumbsup:
